card.name: The letter G starting a word
card.fires_on: The letter g (often capital G) when it starts a new word after a break, such as the Gault in Cockcroft and Gault, or g in gilded, glass, gels. It is strongest on a lone G that begins a name or word.

modes.label: Cockcroft and Gault
modes.description: The G that begins Gault in the creatinine clearance equation.

modes.label: Lone g starting a word
modes.description: A single g letter that begins a word such as gilded, glass or gels, after a hyphen or space.

modes.label: Quoted names
modes.description: A G opening a quoted foreign name or term.

card.writes: It suppresses word starts like ver and sul and promotes mal and orth, so it adds little clear output.
card.plain: It fires when a word starts with a lone letter G, most of all in the Cockcroft and Gault kidney formula.
